decisions.reason: Compliance with a law, custom, command or rule is explicit; keep holiday celebration and watching as separate senses.
The source supplies acquisition as a clear meaning; obtaining something does not always require a procurement procedure.
The military candidate mismatches lessee, and the residence candidate includes merely being born somewhere; neither clearly verifies possession under a lease.
An eighth of a circle or 45-degree arc is explicit; restrict the geometric meaning rather than treating it as every sector.
The only entry depends on unexplained odontology; it does not independently explain the intended dental specialist.
Something offered, such as a proposal or bid, is a clear commercial meaning without importing religious contributions.
Holding an appointed or elected public office is explicitly described and related to politician, without requiring election in every case.
Government officials and civil servants are explicitly identified; criticism of their behavior is not inherent to the selected meaning.
The ulna's bony elbow point is precisely described and directly supports elbow anatomy rather than the entire joint.
One of a small group of influential sellers is fully explained and distinguished from a single monopolist.
The exact physical navel sense fits body vocabulary; exclude the religious artifact, theological proposition and metaphorical hub meanings.
No exact plural source sense or reviewed onlooker mapping is available; the old audience gloss cannot substitute for evidence.
The sole definition repeats operable without explaining the system's ability to function; retain hidden pending clearer factual meaning.
Defining a concept so it can be practically measured is explicit; this is narrower than implementing any policy.
A snake or serpent in Serpentes is a clear zoological meaning directly supported by the academic snake anchor.
The arranger writing for orchestras matches the music-adaptation context; do not infer generic project coordination from the circular candidate.
Someone creating or founding something is explicitly described; an issuer or sender is not automatically its original creator.
The platform over a ship's hold forming its lowest deck is precisely described and relevant to ship-deck terminology.
No exact plural source sense or reviewed ornament mapping is present; decorative jewelry cannot be inferred from old glosses alone.
A salt or ester of orthophosphoric acid is exact chemistry evidence; it is not restricted to a bare ion or presented as dietary advice.
A skeletal framework or underlying structure is clearly defined; distinguish the whole framework from an individual bone.
Ejecting or forcing someone out is self-contained and matches displacement without necessarily implying a replacement.
No exact source entry verifies the plural expense meaning; a reviewed base or plural identity mapping remains necessary.
The ground-contact underside of footwear is explicit and appropriate to shoe materials; it is not merely the heel.
The hand moving forward and down from above shoulder level clearly defines the intended sports motion, excluding excess weaponry.
Providing excessive pay or reward is explicitly sourced and matches overpay; the psychological compensation sense is separate.
Filling a region beyond its population capacity is fully explained and more specific than every instance of crowding.
Rewarding excessively is a clear transitive meaning related to overpay, without restricting rewards to money.
Attempting to buy more shares than available is explicitly explained; reject the old denial that this can describe the buying action.
The sheep-related adjective is fully described, including its comparison qualification; exclude the figurative submissive-person sense.
Egg-shaped with tapering at one end is explicit and supports shape vocabulary without adding an unsourced dimensional rule.
Containing oxygen does not establish an aerobic-exercise meaning; the sole fitness anchor confuses environmental oxygen with exercise physiology.
Oxygen-containing or producing processes do not verify equivalence to aerobic exercise; the fitness topic mismatch remains.
The elephant sense is explicitly informal; retain that restriction rather than the old recommendation to use it as a formal scientific term.
The source verifies a lotus blossom, not the fitness lotus posture; cultural association alone does not resolve the intended exercise meaning.
The cerebral-cortex sense directly matches the academic anatomy anchor; exclude clothing, religious vestments and invertebrate structures.
The tank sense, especially German World War II, is clearly sourced for historical reading; not every tank is necessarily German.
A person trained to assist a professional is fully explained; this category extends beyond paralegals and legal workplaces.
Functional organ tissue contrasted with supporting tissue is a precise academic biological meaning, not a replacement for every tissue.
No exact plural entry or reviewed parenthesis mapping is present; the proposed formal-register distinction is also unsupported.
